description: Workflows that hand repository secrets to third-party code: a deploy workflow passing the Vercel token to amondnet/vercel-action and the server's SSH private key to appleboy/ssh-action through their with: blocks (both on mutable tags), and the Slack incoming-webhook URL to slackapi/slack-github-action through the step's env: (the action reads it from its environment); a release workflow giving the npm publish token to cycjimmy/semantic-release-action through env: alone, with no with: inputs; and an API workflow calling another org's reusable deploy workflow with the Fly API token in its secrets: block, then that org's Slack-notify workflow with only a secrets: block. A compromised action or workflow (as with tj-actions/changed-files in March 2025) can exfiltrate them. VC187 must fire on each of those six uses: lines. The env:-only step and the secrets:-only call have no with: block, which the old 800-char regex required.
